# Get Wi-Fi Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the devices WiFi.

## Syntax

~~~~text
wifiDetails(detail: <#Enumeration (WFWiFiDetail)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
wifiDetails(detail: Network Name)
~~~~
